Lemma
1. ch3:3.23A connected homogeneous Riemannian manifold with a point reflection at one point is symmetric.
Proof

\sketch Let $\varphi $ reflect at $p$. For $q\in M$, choose an isometry $\psi $ with $\psi (p)=q$. Then $\widetilde\varphi =\psi \circ \varphi \circ \psi ^{-1}$ fixes $q$ and

\[ d\widetilde\varphi _q =d\psi _p\circ (-\operatorname {Id}_{T_pM})\circ d(\psi ^{-1})_q =-\operatorname {Id}_{T_qM}. \]

□
